text:
JULIET:
  How did you get in here? Tell me. And why?
  The orchard walls are high and hard to climb.
  And this place is death for you, considering who you are,
  if any of my family finds you here.
ROMEO:
  Love gave me light wings, and I flew over these walls.
  Stone walls can't keep love out.
  Whatever love can do, love dares to try.
  So your family can't stop me.
JULIET:
  If they see you, they'll murder you.
